import json, urllib.request, ssl

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
prom = "http://10.10.20.30:9090"

def prom_query(expr):
    try:
        url = f"{prom}/api/v1/query?query={urllib.request.quote(expr)}"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url)
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        return data.get("data", {}).get("result", [])
    except Exception as e:
        return []

# Host health (up metric from node_exporter â€” jobs end in -node)
up_results = prom_query('up{job=~".*-node"}')
hosts_up = sum(1 for r in up_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
hosts_total = len(up_results)

# Blackbox service health (blackbox-http and blackbox-icmp)
svc_results = prom_query('probe_success{job=~"blackbox-.*"}')
svcs_up = sum(1 for r in svc_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
svcs_total = len(svc_results)

# Worst disk usage (all node exporter targets, root mount)
disk_results = prom_query('100 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100)')
worst_disk = "N/A"
worst_pct = 0
for r in disk_results:
    pct = float(r["value"][1])
    job = r["metric"].get("job", "unknown")
    host = job.replace("-node", "") if job.endswith("-node") else r["metric"].get("instance", "unknown")
    if pct > worst_pct:
        worst_pct = pct
        worst_disk = f"{host} ({pct:.0f}%)"

section = f"INFRASTRUCTURE\\nHosts: {hosts_up}/{hosts_total} HEALTHY\\nServices: {svcs_up}/{svcs_total} UP\\nDisk Watch: {worst_disk}"
print(json.dumps({"section": section}))

import json, urllib.request, ssl, base64

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
creds = "$opensearch_user:$opensearch_pass"
auth = base64.b64encode(creds.encode()).decode()
headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Basic {auth}"}

# Capitol Signals: alerts last 24h
try:
    q1 = {"size": 0, "track_total_hits": True, "query": {"range": {"timestamp": {"gte": "now-24h"}}}}
    req1 = urllib.request.Request("$opensearch_url/cs-alerts-*/_search",
        data=json.dumps(q1).encode(), headers=headers, method="POST")
    resp1 = urllib.request.urlopen(req1, context=ctx, timeout=10)
    cs_alerts = json.loads(resp1.read().decode())["hits"]["total"]["value"]
except:
    cs_alerts = "N/A"

# Capitol Signals: total trades tracked
try:
    q2 = {"size": 0, "track_total_hits": True, "query": {"match_all": {}}}
    req2 = urllib.request.Request("$opensearch_url/cs-trades-*/_search",
        data=json.dumps(q2).encode(), headers=headers, method="POST")
    resp2 = urllib.request.urlopen(req2, context=ctx, timeout=10)
    cs_trades = json.loads(resp2.read().decode())["hits"]["total"]["value"]
except:
    cs_trades = "N/A"

# AlgoTrader status
try:
    req3 = urllib.request.Request("http://10.10.20.30:8081/api/system/status")
    resp3 = urllib.request.urlopen(req3, timeout=5)
    at_data = json.loads(resp3.read().decode())
    at_status = at_data.get("status", "unknown")
    at_pnl = at_data.get("daily_pnl", at_data.get("pnl", "N/A"))
    at_line = f"{at_status} | PnL: {at_pnl}"
except Exception as e:
    at_line = f"Unreachable ({str(e)[:40]})"

section = f"PROJECTS\\nCapitol Signals: {cs_alerts} alerts (24h), {cs_trades} trades total\\nAlgoTrader: {at_line}"
print(json.dumps({"section": section}))
